Standardise series identifiers to SITE_SpAb### style

Source: R/naming.R
dm_repair_series.Rd

Rewrites raw series names to the standard form <site>_<SpeciesAbv><number> (e.g. "TIL_Ps699"), extracting species letters and tree numbers where possible. repair_series_HOLstyle() is the original DendroMatic name, kept as an exported alias.

Usage

repair_series_HOLstyle(
  series_vec,
  site_tag,
  default_species_abv = NA_character_
)

dm_repair_series(series_vec, site_tag, default_species_abv = NA_character_)

Arguments

series_vec

Character vector of raw series names.

site_tag

Site code (e.g. "TIL").

default_species_abv

Fallback species code when letters cannot be parsed from a name.

Value

A tibble with columns series_old and series_new.
